↓ gateway → gate, ↑ gate → gateway. Wireframe = simulated by the virtual node (not on air). Packet motion is illustrative (240 ms); node updates follow observed or simulated radio timing.

      

    


    


    

      

      

        Gates and nodes
        
Link each gate to a real node (seen over LoRa or attached over USB) or keep it simulated. A linked gate shows what the real node receives; clicking it opens that node's WLED UI. Up to 8 gates. A double or triple gate shows its gate configuration per square (Presets tab, Squares); squares beyond it repeat the lowest square.

        

        

      

      

    


    

      
Real gate boards attached over USB (Control → Radio link → Attach node). Their own serial output shows what arrived over the air and what the node did with it.

      

    


    

      
      

      
Node log

      

      
The virtual node runs the GateLink usermod logic (JS port) and renders the LEDs with a JS port of WLED v16 effects. Effects that are not ported yet show as Solid.
